mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stat_daily (user_id, stat_date, answered_count, correct_count, duration_sec) VALUES (#{userId}, #{statDate}, #{answeredDelta}, #{correctDelta}, #{durationSecDelta}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE answered_count = answered_count + VALUES(answered_count), correct_count = correct_count + VALUES(correct_count), duration_sec = duration_sec + VALUES(duration_sec)
